answer: Make every agent ID solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle each epoch before it can attest: about 4 GB of RAM for 90 seconds, seeded by the epoch beacon so nothing can be precomputed. One honest agent barely notices, but a raven-dark farm of 500 fakes must rent 2 TB of memory every hour, so the attack bill grows with each identity. Rewards then rise like a terrace of rice fields, step by step with uptime, and a lotus of trust opens only after 30 straight epochs.
